title: Power BI for public health and programmes
why: Programme and surveillance data only drive decisions when they are timely, visual and trusted.
what_is_different: Public health dashboards combine facility data, survey data and population denominators; they need disaggregation (age, sex, location), maps, and careful handling of small numbers and data quality.

extra_modules.title: Indicators with denominators
extra_modules.outcome: You can: calculate rates and coverage correctly
extra_modules.practice: Build coverage indicators by district with targets

starter_project: Build a programme dashboard: indicator coverage by district on a map, trends against targets, and a data-quality page.
pitfalls: Publishing small numbers that identify people

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
